alpha2-verify.description: Verify one reviewed pinwash commit on the EC pool: run the complete stdlib unittest suite, require nonzero tests and no skips, require doctor to run the same tests successfully, and compare raw findings JSON from two independent processes with different PYTHONHASHSEED values. Record the exact source SHA, runtime, commands, exit codes, test counts, and output hashes. No dependency installation, subject execution, network requests, cache, or publication from the workload.

live-fire-rejudge.description: Re-judge the published live-fire rounds 0-4 offline on the EC pool and compare with the published records. Inputs are only files in the dispatched commit: the 196 files listed in live-fire/MANIFEST.json (each verified; the MANIFEST itself is pinned at sha256 04e4abbef8a1ed76c6350f1bb75e87b9804cb84b7fd5b5c362ca27514e65f5cd), workloads/live_fire_rejudge/judges.bundle (git bundle of pinwash history; each judge is proven by commit id and pinwash/ tree id: 416b962ca08623531be180e0a4d0613001d38776, 86bdccee9c5b63e92b1c3ef21af61374c078db15, 9dec33210208b2715b62085fa433ded04fffc14f, df5eb217f31f02cded1b29628cadfacb781fabcb, 7222bfcbabeea1047680aa8f6d3fbb488a1a3e92), and workloads/live_fire_rejudge/expected_worktrees.json (sha256 of every file in the 91 original cell worktrees except the driver outputs, Python caches, .git/ and one file named nul, as listed in its excluded field; hashed from the original cells on the maintainer's work machine by file reads only). The workload rebuilds the fixture base and requires commit 2354c96be0b9a390c7785ad3591d43c56278ada1, rebuilds every cell from its change.patch and requires its worktree bytes to equal expected_worktrees.json, then runs python -m pinwash check in every cell with the judge of each record and the ranges that record used (round 0: worktree only; round 1 spec 7: 2354c96..HEAD and worktree; all others: the full BASE..HEAD and worktree), twice with different PYTHONHASHSEED values, projects the output the way that record was projected, and compares canonical JSON. Primary records that must match: round 0 post-quiescence re-judge (416b962), round 1 spec 7 re-judge (86bdcce, inferred: that record names no revision), rounds 2, 3 and 4 drive-time (9dec332, df5eb21, 7222bfc), and the round 3 spec 9 delta (7222bfc). Round 0 and round 1 drive-time records and the never-judged round 1 first-launch cell are reported only. No judgment starts later than 50 minutes after the workload starts; anything left counts as not run. Records the exact source SHA, runtime, judge identities, rebuild checks, every comparison and raw judge stdout. pinwash only reads the cells; no subject code, network request, dependency installation, model, cache or publication from the workload.

candidate-sessions.description: Offline preregistered candidate session CLI integration for spec36 engine tree 8f3dd1e10dc590d0bc0d3335817d81648b36b4e4 from a5af21c166b1522a4e0d9d4074ff9bdd299a5ef5. Require the fixed SPEC hash and cases.json SHA-256 0532ad3347d7563e1f29a3fda3515ca412bcc6cbb677f0aa62922907b0702292. Assemble 27 literal disposable Git fixtures, run trusted harness tests and all three README session scans in independent processes with PYTHONHASHSEED 1 and 17 (162 scans). Require exact findings, unknown rows, exit codes, held/block/pass recipe outcomes, SPEC fingerprints, raw JSON equality and unchanged source/subject files. Use only stdlib Python and Git with hooks disabled; no subject execution, dependency installation, network requests, host hook probes, models, cache or publication. Record exact dispatcher and candidate identities, runtime, raw logs, commands, cleanup and every failed/NOT_RUN case. This workload does not run the full product suite or doctor, replay historical cells, measure held-out accuracy or claim an OS/Python matrix. Current fixture scratch is created only in EC_WORKLOAD_WORK and removed with bounded ownership/reparse/read-only-file checks. After all cases match and current scratch cleanup succeeds, recover only the failed run38510675237/1 scratch C:/Users/S3452MA/AppData/Local/Temp/pinwash-candidate-hubxl1c3 on named LAPTOP-8KGL8EFS, pinned by recovery.json SHA-256 278af37c6e0033a552fc38664478c127f48d42a03cd1d9a89c4e44617e9e7178 and immutable receipt feae654459d5a8b1cb4ed7ad30a77e0f362ebd6e. Verify every remaining non-Git file against its recorded hash, reject unexpected files and symlinks/reparse points, clear only an actual read-only bit on an owned ordinary file if deletion is denied, and read back absence. No other temporary root or user data is selected; failure retains the exact residual path and stays FAIL.
